name: IC Interface USB — USB, UART/serial — MSOP
description: Surface-mount USB interface IC cluster in MSOP packaging supporting USB and UART/serial functions.
selection_hints: Require surface-mount USB and UART/serial interface ICs.
Target designs using the MSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm footprint.
Select from Tier A representative parts CH340E or FSUSB42MUX.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
Footprints other than MSOP-10_3x3mm_P0.5mm are needed.
Interface functionality other than USB or UART/serial is required.
